business_summary: Voltage Incorporation engages in the planning, production, development, sale, and administration of entertainment content in Japan and internationally. It is also involved in the management of a digital comic book store; production and sale of original label works; planning and hosting of events; and design and sale of merchandise, consumer games, movies, and music. In addition, the company offers AmuLit, a console game brand. It provides its mobile content over the internet through mobile devices. Voltage Incorporation was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
